description:
➡️ Notes link: Shared in the Member Community Post (If you are Member of this channel, then pls check the Member community post, i have shared the Notes link there)

➡️ Join this channel to get access to member only perks:
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCDJ2HAZ_hW-DMJj_U0zN38w/join

I have covered: 
- Transaction Manager and its Hierarchy

- Declarative approach of transaction management

- Programmatic approach of transaction management (Transaction Template)

- Different types of Propagation like:
REQUIRED Propagation
NOT_REQUIRED Propagation
SUPPORTS Propagation
NOT_SUPPORTED Propagation
MANDATORY Propagation
NEVER Propagation

Part1 video of Transaction Management: https://youtu.be/Kf-gAW8hGQA
